pages.name: Game Mode Selection
pages.description: Initial screen allowing players to choose between Local PvP and Unbeatable CPU modes before starting a match

components.name: SetupPage
components.description: Top-level container for mode selection, handles initial state and navigation to game board. Supports keyboard navigation via arrow keys and Enter/Space.

components.name: ModeSelector
components.description: Radio-group style selector for game modes. Highlights active selection and disables invalid states during navigation.

components.name: StartButton
components.description: Primary action button to initialize the game session with the chosen mode. Disabled until a mode is selected.

userFlows: Select Local PvP or CPU mode → Click Start Game → Redirect to /play with selected mode

pages.name: Active Game Board
pages.description: Main gameplay interface featuring the 3x3 grid, turn indicator, scoreboard, and reset controls. Enforces strict turn alternation and prevents overwriting.

components.name: GamePage
components.description: Orchestrates game state, win/draw detection, and CPU move timing. Manages session persistence across resets.

components.name: Scoreboard
components.description: Displays persistent session scores for Player X, Player O, and draws. Updates instantly on match conclusion.

components.name: TurnIndicator
components.description: Visual and textual indicator showing whose turn it is. Shows animated 'CPU thinking' state during Minimax evaluation.

components.name: GameGrid
components.description: 3x3 grid layout rendering nine interactive cells. Handles click delegation, enforces empty-cell validation, and applies winning line highlights.

components.name: GridCell
components.description: Individual board cell. Displays X/O symbols, handles click events, and prevents interaction when occupied or game is over.

components.name: ResetButton
components.description: Clears board state and resets turn order to X without page refresh or score modification. Accessible via Tab and activated with Enter/Space.

components.name: ResultOverlay
components.description: Modal overlay that appears on win or draw. Displays result message, highlights winning combination, and provides rematch/reset action.

userFlows: Click empty cell → Symbol placed → Turn alternates → Win/Draw detected → Result overlay appears → Click Reset → Board clears, scores persist, X starts
CPU mode active → Player moves → CPU evaluates within 500ms → CPU places optimal move → Turn returns to player

componentLibrary: Tailwind CSS with custom components, following the project's tech stack
responsiveStrategy: Mobile-first design. Breakpoints: sm (640px) for tablets, lg (1024px) for desktop. Grid scales from 100vw on mobile to fixed 400px container on desktop. Mode selector stacks vertically on mobile, aligns horizontally on sm+.
accessibilityLevel: WCAG 2.1 AA — all interactive elements keyboard-navigable, all images/content have text alternatives, color contrast minimum 4.5:1
colorPalette: Primary: #2563EB (actions, links), Success: #16A34A (completion), Error: #DC2626 (deletion, validation), Warning: #F59E0B, Neutral: #F3F4F6 (background), #6B7280 (secondary text)
typography: Sans-serif system font stack. Headings: text-2xl to text-4xl, font-semibold. Body: text-sm to text-base, font-normal
designTokens: radius: rounded-lg (8px) for cards/modals, rounded (4px) for buttons/inputs
shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for modals, shadow-lg for dropdowns
